---
title: A filename code block inside a callout
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            'div.callout div.code-with-filename div.code-with-filename-file',
            'div.callout div.code-copy-outer-scaffold button.code-copy-button',
          ]
---

Regression fixture for bd-akkproqy: `code-block-generate` runs while a
callout is still a `Callout` custom node (since #1050), so it must walk into
the callout's slots or the block loses its filename header and copy
scaffold. q2-preview does not render these decorations for any code block
yet (bd-3zc4sye5), so this fixture's DOM checks run on native render only.

::: {.callout-note}
```{.python filename="x.py"}
x = 1
```
:::
